# Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Sales Snap Pack

The Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Sales Snap Pack provides access to all business entities exposed through MS Dynamics 365 web services.

[Book a Demo](https://www.snaplogic.com/request-demo)

* * *

## Key Features of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Sales Snap Pack

![Easily Integrate Microsoft Dynamics 365 - Snaps Explained](https://www.snaplogic.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/08/Snaps-Explained-Thumbnail-Microsoft-Dynamics-365.jpg)

The SnapLogic Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Sales Snap Pack provides access to all business entities exposed through MS Dynamics 365 web services. The data available through SnapLogic includes common entities such as Contact, Accounts, Leads, and Opportunities as well as support for custom MS Dynamics 365 for Sales entities. The MS Dynamics 365 for Sales Snaps do not require any additional setup or configuration within MS Dynamics for Sales. After installation, data from MS Dynamics 365 for Sales can be accessed in SnapLogic without any additional programming. MS Dynamics CRM Snaps perform “Create,” “Read,” “Update,” “Delete,” and “Execute” actions. Finally, users have to just provide the credential information is needed.

For connectivity between SnapLogic and MS Dynamics 365 for Sales, this Snap Pack uses the MS Dynamics 365 for Sales REST interface, eliminating the need for additional configuration.

This Snap Pack supports the following operations:

- Create a record
- Read and write a single record of all records from the specified category
- Update an existing record
- Delete a record
- Execute a record

Learn more about how Snaps work with the SnapLogic Intelligent Integration Platform [**here**](https://www.snaplogic.com/products).
